body.statement: Using exact rational rank intersections over every coordinate of \(\theta_{K_6}\), determine whether \(\operatorname{Cl}_4(K_6)=\theta_{K_6}\). If equality holds, certify the complete closure transcript and reject cycle length alone as evidence of degree growth; if it fails, return a proper fixed point and use its surviving multigrading to calibrate the windmill obstruction in \(\mathrm{oeq:sharp\mbox{-}frontier}\).
body.justification: This bounded computation destroys the most tempting false growth heuristic before the asymptotic family is frozen.
body.gap: Tree-cycle papers prove sound quadratic elimination, but neither they nor the degree-bounded algorithm compute the source-defined minimum degree for this outside-HTC two-cycle graph.
body.consumer: The windmill program receives either a concrete low-degree multigrading or an immediate warning that two-cycle length cannot support its lower exponent.

obligation.what_is_open: The exact decision whether \(\operatorname{Cl}_4(K_6)=\theta_{K_6}\), including either all intersection witnesses or an exact proper fixed-point rank transcript.
obligation.obstruction: After the immediately identifiable root variance, the degree-four test is a large exact symbolic intersection problem. No rank equality proving a proper fixed point and no nullspace witnesses proving full closure are available in the frozen primitives or the presolve evidence.
obligation.attempted: The residual missing-edge equations were reduced to the two coupled triangle systems, and the exact degree-four monomial dimensions were computed. The known cancellation of two quadratic cycle equations only gives a higher-degree rational route and does not decide the degree-four recursive intersections, especially after disturbance-coordinate adjunctions.
obligation.partial_result: The exact closure step currently certified is \(\omega_{11}=s_{11}\), hence \(\omega_{11}\in\operatorname{Cl}_1(K_6)\subseteq\operatorname{Cl}_4(K_6)\).  After this duplicate coordinate is adjoined, deciding availability of one remaining coordinate at degree four requires the exact intersection of the span of \(\binom{21+4}{4}=12650\) covariance monomial images with the coordinate multiple of the span of \(\binom{21+3}{3}=2024\) degree-at-most-three images.  No equality or proper fixed-point certificate for the resulting closure has been established here.
